Two independent lists; the run matrix is their product.
sites  — WHERE tests run. A URL plus the admin credentials to use.
Every suite is handed these as E2E_BASE_URL / E2E_ADMIN_USER /
E2E_ADMIN_PASS, so a suite that reads those can be pointed at
any registered site from the dashboard's dropdown.
suites — HOW tests run. A directory plus which framework it uses:
Omit 'framework' to auto-detect from the files on disk.
sites        — restrict which sites this suite may target (default: all)
defaultSite  — the site preselected in the dropdown
env          — extra environment variables for this suite's runs
scopes       — split one suite into separately selectable slices, each
with its own default site (for a suite whose specs are
organised per product/tenant). See the example below.
